name: techlead_rework
_comment: Developer returns FEASIBLE, but the Tech-Lead control review rejects once (ARCHITECT_REVIEW_NEEDS_REVISION) -> back into the Architect<->Developer loop -> Developer FEASIBLE again -> Tech-Lead READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW -> PASS at iteration 2. Proves the Tech-Lead-rejection back-edge (not straight to the arbiter) below techlead_reject_before_arbiter. ARCH-02 (2026-08-31, development run 2): that rejection overturns a FEASIBLE result, so it is now assessed for gate departure (arch.semantic_gate_departure) BEFORE it changes tl_rejects. The Tech Lead projects its blocker into the canonical `## Architecture Blocking Findings` manifest (TL-1-B1), the assessment returns JUSTIFIED_GATE_DEPARTURE and retains it, tl_rejects becomes 1 (still below the threshold) and the finding travels to the author as its one-shot active manifest. Draft 2 answers it and returns the `## Blocker Dispositions` transport block, which the engine strips from architecture-draft-02.md / architecture-final.md while the raw arch.author step keeps it - that ACCEPTED disposition is the run's whole quality signal (accepted 1 / eligible 1). The route and terminal status are otherwise unchanged.
